#   IANA Addresses › Multicast Networks
#   
#   This list contains IPv4 multicast address space assigned by the
#   Internet Assigned Numbers Authority (IANA) for multicast and
#   group-based network communication.
#   
#   The dataset currently contains:
#      - 224.0.0.0/4 (IPv4 multicast space)
#   
#   Multicast addresses are used to deliver packets from one sender
#   to multiple subscribed hosts simultaneously and are commonly used
#   by routing protocols, streaming systems, service discovery, and
#   internal network communication services.
#   
#   Multicast traffic is not intended for standard public internet
#   host communication and is typically restricted to controlled
#   network environments or specialized routing configurations.
#   
#   Public-facing traffic involving multicast address space may indicate
#   spoofed packets, malformed traffic, amplification attempts, or
#   network misconfiguration.
#   
#   This list is sourced from officially assigned IANA special-purpose
#   address registries and updated periodically as standards evolve.
